The '''Ancient Sith crypt''' was an old [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tomb by [[3627 BBY]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. During that year, many [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who entered the tomb were possessed and driven crazy. The Ancient Sith crypt held many Sith scriptures including the [[Tome of Freedon Nadd]].

The Sith crypt was inhabited by [[Rill (species)|crypt Lizard]]s.
